# SearXNG Gateway Domain Blacklist
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
# Subdomains are automatically matched (e.g. 'geeksforgeeks.org' matches 'www.geeksforgeeks.org', 'sub.geeksforgeeks.org').
